slides.title: Read the documented operation
slides.notes: Use official pygame.Rect.colliderect, pygame.time.Clock.tick and Python open documentation. colliderect expects a rectangle-like value and returns a Boolean using strict edge overlap. tick(60) returns elapsed milliseconds and limits a target rate; it does not prove fixed FPS or responsiveness. open returns a file object or raises an error; append changes persistent storage. slides.title: Build the HUD and score history
slides.notes: FR8 accepts final integer scores in the game range0..50. Do not silently narrow this to preparation values0..2 or0/2/4/6. Preserve old records; show an empty message; skip malformed/out-of-range lines with a warning. For [20,0,50,50], first maximum is zero-based index2. On failed save, report it and keep gameplay usable; any retry follows the student’s stated policy without falsely claiming success. Simulate failure only with disposable paths.
